propositions: _paged_search loop in _base.py has no offset-stall guard and spins forever when the DC server ignores or repeats startAt offsets instead of advancing pages

get_parent_map and all three fetch_snapshot enrichment handlers have broad fail-open exception clauses that swallow pagination stall errors, converting loud failures into silent empty/degraded results
a startAt-ignoring stub server causes 26 pager calls with offsets [0,3,6,...] while receiving the same page repeatedly, terminating only by harness cap rather than self-detection
the three whole-project readers (issuelinks, comments, parent relationships) all feed through fail-open boundaries in fetcher.py that do not name or re-raise pagination stall errors
fetcher._iter_pages and acli_graph already implement stall guards raising SilentTruncationError and RunawayPaginationError respectively; DC pagination is the missing sibling
